svg.title: Example program creation: eight prompt sections
svg.desc: Build a program brief by specifying the goal, audience, journey, email content, LinkedIn activation, registration handling, post-event follow-up, and settings. The journey splits by intent, sends personalized invitations, merges and waits, then branches by engagement. Registered members exit the invitation journey. These are prompt sections, not a journey execution sequence.
svg.text: From campaign goal to program brief
Eight prompt sections to describe the program you want to create
Program goal
Experience Cloud Leadership Forum - AI-Powered Experience Summit
August 3 to December 3 | Email + LinkedIn | Venue, time, and start mode
Audience
Experience Cloud product intent + engagement score greater than 1
Exclude unsubscribed and marketing-suspended profiles.
Journey
Next Best Path: split by Experience Cloud intent
High: tailored invitation
Medium: tailored invitation
Low: tailored invitation
Merge + wait 2 days, then check engagement and registrations
Engaged: agenda preview | Non-engaged: LinkedIn + wait 2 days | Reminder: 10 days before event
Email content
Executive Invitation + Agenda Preview + Final Registration Reminder
Define subject lines, preheaders, calls to action, and image requirements.
Personalize using person, persona, industry, interest, and engagement data.
LinkedIn activation
Reach non-engaged members with sponsored content about
customer experience transformation and AI personalization.
Registration handling
Immediately exit registered members from the invitation journey.
Send preparation email: personalized agenda, venue, sessions, and calendar link.
Post-event follow-up
Attendees: follow-up program with recap, recordings, and sales review.
No-shows: summit highlights, on-demand content, and future invitations.
Settings
Set reply-to and sender tokens. Enable Send Time Optimization for all emails.
Reuse a template; vary city, venue, keynote topics, and industry focus.
Use these sections in a brief or a direct request. They are not a journey execution sequence.
Review the generated program and approve the result.
